_source: Reference outputs generated by ZKNoxHQ/ETHDILITHIUM@b9ca7f72526ecc696230d3c774a6e2c12c9b37c2 — equivalent to running pythonref/prepare_pk_for_deployment.py (the canonical tool that emits the on-chain deployment payload). Shape: `abi.encode((bytes, bytes, bytes), [abi.encode(uint256[][][], aHat_compact), tr, abi.encode(uint256[][], t1_compact)])` where aHat / t1 are packed via 8 × 32-bit coefficients per uint256 word. This is byte-identical to what `_readPubKey` in ZKNOX_ethdilithium.sol decodes on-chain. Cross-referenced to ml-dsa-44-eth-KAT.rsp by `count`. Regenerate against the pinned ETHDILITHIUM SHA on upstream change.
